newsitem.title: FRANCE: Pilots at Air France Europe call strike Nov 15-16.
newsitem.headline: Pilots at Air France Europe call strike Nov 15-16.

text.p: Pilots' unions at Air France Europe, part of the Air France group, called a 48-hour strike on Friday and Saturday to protest at planned job cuts.

Unions said all flights risked cancellation, coinciding with calls by major French unions for new protests on the first anniversary of a controversial welfare reform plan unveiled by Prime Minister Alain Juppe on November 15, 1995.

The airline said it was too early to predict likely disruption from the stoppage, called by the USPNT, SPIT, SNPNAC and SPNL unions. The unions also said they were calling another 48-hour strike on November 27 and 28.

Air France Europe, with a network of mainly domestic flights, has been battered by strikes in recent months over plans to formally merge the airline, previously known as Air Inter, with parent Air France.
A restructuring foresees shedding 950 jobs out of 11,000 over two years.
